name: feature-tracker
description: Features pane beside plan-tracker: the repo's modules and their features from a hand-editable features.md, an opus review per module (missing features, tech debt, missing handling, test gaps, security, improvements) logged as checkbox notes in Obsidian or docs/features/, with each finding listed in the pane to pick and plan.

notesDir.title: Notes folder
notesDir.description: Absolute path to an Obsidian folder holding one folder per project (e.g. ~/.obsidian/MyVault/Projects). Empty keeps features.md and reviews in <repo>/docs/features.
